question: Do direct one-step changes to Scientific Method's price or Industrial Velocity's discount compress the causal Demis and Elon faction effects while preserving three-, four-, and five-player viability and avoiding new dominance?

selectionRule.imperialCandidate: Select only if Demis moves materially toward parity at four players, improves the three-player extreme, remains viable at five, and creates no registered dominance or integrity failure.
selectionRule.verticalCandidate: Select only if Elon moves materially toward parity at four players, remains viable at three and five, and creates no registered dominance or integrity failure.
selectionRule.pairedAuthority: Compare each candidate only with canonical under common seeds. Do not combine the candidates in this experiment.
selectionRule.precision: Treat multiplicity-adjusted intervals and partially pooled faction cells as authority; do not select from a noisy worst raw cell.
selectionRule.physicalBoundary: The probe cannot establish human negotiation quality, perceived faction identity, duration, fairness, Realignment drama, or fun.
selectionRule.promotion: A candidate remains simulation-only until a tracked receipt, all-surface audit, and explicit user approval.
